title: Herbed Greek Lamb Kebabs
description: Delicious lamb kebabs marinated in a blend of herbs and spices, perfect for a summer evening. This recipe is a classic Greek dish with a flavorful twist.

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.notes: shoulder or leg, cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, olive oil, parsley, oregano, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Thread lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush kebabs with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking.
Let kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as roasted vegetables or a salad.
